source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Whenever this unit or any enemy unit finishes a move, resolve this for every model of this unit within 3" of an enemy unit: pick 1 of those enemy units, destroy the model, then roll 1 D6:

- 2-5: the picked unit takes 1 **[mortal wound](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)**
- 6: the picked unit takes D3 mortal wounds

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 10 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
